Rashi on Pesachim 111a:10:1.english: Let us open with "lo" and conclude with "lo" - "Not a man is God..." until "...not fulfill it" (ibid.).

Rashi on Pesachim 111a:11:1.english: She kills one of them - For she harms them by passing between them.

Rashi on Pesachim 111a:12:1.english: Agra, Azlat, Osiya, Belusiya - [These are] those demons with which you are engaged.

Rashi on Pesachim 111a:12:2.english: They are killed by arrows - They are already killed by arrows.

Rashi on Pesachim 111a:12:3.hebrew: חיק קבל - אר"ק בלישטר"א, כמו ומחי קבלו יתן [בחומותיך] (בחרבותיו) (יחזקאל כ״ו:ט׳). מפי המורה הגמ' ומקרא אשר שמע מפי רבו:
Rashi on Pesachim 111a:12:3.english: Cheik kaval - [In Old French,] arc balestre [a crossbow], like, "And he shall set his battering engines [against your walls] (with his axes)" (Ezekiel 26:9). From the mouth of the teacher — [regarding both] the Gemara and Scripture — which he heard from the mouth of his teacher.

Rashi on Pesachim 111a:14:1.hebrew: דקל יחידי - שאין דקל אחר סמוך לו, אבל כשיש דקל אחר, מסתלקת השידא לדקל האחר ואינה מזיקתו:
Rashi on Pesachim 111a:14:1.english: A single palm tree - Where there is no other palm tree near it; however, when there is another palm tree, the female demon departs to the other palm tree and does not harm him.

Rashi on Pesachim 111a:15:1.hebrew: בחצר - שהמקום צר, ואין לה דרך לנטות ימין ושמאל, ושורה עליו ומזיקתו:
Rashi on Pesachim 111a:15:1.english: In a courtyard - Because the place is narrow, and [the demon] has no way to turn right or left, and [it] rests upon him and harms him.

Rashi on Pesachim 111a:1:1.hebrew: חוץ ממים - מזוגים, כגון קרירי בחמימי וחמימי בקרירי, דמיא לא מזיגא היא, ואם היה שותה בתחלה יין, אין אלו מצטרפות לו:
Rashi on Pesachim 111a:1:1.english: Except for water - [Even] diluted [water], such as cold [water] in hot [water] and hot [water] in cold [water], for water is not [considered] diluted, and if he was initially drinking wine, these [cups] do not combine with it.

Rashi on Pesachim 111a:1:2.english: And we only said - [that] mixed water does not combine with diluted wine.

Rashi on Pesachim 111a:2:1.english: Four matters - All of them [are] because of an evil spirit.

Rashi on Pesachim 111a:3:1.hebrew: אלא דלא הוי ד' אמות - דלא שביק רווחא [לשידא] לעבור בין דקל לכותל, משום הכי מזקא ליה:
Rashi on Pesachim 111a:3:1.english: Only when there are not four cubits - For he does not leave space [for the demon] to pass between the palm tree and the wall; therefore, it harms him.

Rashi on Pesachim 111a:3:2.hebrew: אלא דליכא דירכא אחרינא - שתהא שידא יכולה להלך בו, דעכשיו זה בא בגבולה והפסיד דרכה, ואהכי מזקא ליה:
Rashi on Pesachim 111a:3:2.english: Only when there is no other route - For a female demon to be able to walk on it, for now this [person] has entered her boundary and ruined her path, and therefore she harms him.

Rashi on Pesachim 111a:6:1.english: That he did not interrupt them with earth - That he did not scatter earth upon them.

Rashi on Pesachim 111a:7:1.english: [His] shoes shrank - The shoes contracted.

Rashi on Pesachim 111a:7:2.english: And his feet shriveled up - And his feet dried up.

Rashi on Pesachim 111a:8:1.english: [They] do not pass between - They should not pass between two people.

Rashi on Pesachim 111a:8:2.hebrew: ואין מתמצעין - לא יעבור איש אחד בין ב' כלבים, בין שתי נשים, בין שתי דקלים:
Rashi on Pesachim 111a:8:2.english: And they are not passed between - One man should not pass between two dogs, between two women, [or] between two palm trees.

Rashi on Pesachim 111a:9:1.english: We begin with “El” [God] and conclude with “El” - “God [El] who brought them out of Egypt” (Numbers 23:22), “For there is no enchantment with Jacob,” etc., until “what God [El] has wrought.”

Tosafot on Pesachim 111a:11:1.english: If she is at the beginning of menstruation, she kills - There is [one who] explains [that this applies] if she performs witchcraft on them.

Tosafot on Pesachim 111a:9:1.hebrew: נפתח באל - פי' רשב"ם: "אל מוציאם ממצרים", ו"נפתח בלא" — "לא איש אל ויכזב". ואע"ג דאסור להתרפאות בדברי תורה, להגן שרי. והא דאמרי' בפ' במה אשה (שבת דף סז.): "לאישתא צמירתא לישקול סכינא וכו' ולימא ויאמר משה אסורה נא ואראה וגו'" — משום סכנה שרי. ור"ח פי': "נפתח באל" — לימא הכי: "אל אלהים ה' הצילנו מכל רע ומכל נזק, אשר בידך כח וגבורה כי אתה אל"; ו"נפתח בלא" — "לא תטשני אלהי ולא תעזבני, שמרני כאישון בת עין, טרם אקרא תענני ואל תאמר לא":
Tosafot on Pesachim 111a:9:1.english: We should begin with "El" [God] - Rashbam explained [that this refers to the verse]: "El [God] Who brought them out of Egypt" [Numbers 23:22], and [for the phrase] "and we should begin with 'lo' [not]" — [it refers to]: "Lo [God is not] a man that He should lie" [Numbers 23:19]. And even though it is forbidden to heal oneself with words of Torah, to protect [oneself from harm] is permitted. And [as for] that which we say in the chapter [entitled] Bameh Ishah (Shabbat 67a): "For an inflammatory fever, let him take a knife, etc., and say: 'And Moses said, I will turn aside now and see, etc.'" — because of danger [to life] it is permitted. And Rabbeinu Chananel explained: "We should begin with 'El'" — he should say thus: "El [God], Almighty, Lord, save us from all evil and from all harm, for in Your hand is strength and might, for You are El [God]"; and "we should begin with 'lo'" — "Lo [Do not] forsake me, my God, and do not abandon me; guard me like the pupil of the eye; before I call, answer me, and do not say lo [no]."
